system_name: IonQ 256q at Cambridge Cavendish / IonQ Quantum Innovation Centre
headline: IonQ + University of Cambridge: 256q 6th-gen chip-based system at Ray Dolby Centre (Cavendish)
details: Announced 2026-03-11. IonQ's 6th-generation chip-based 256-qubit system to be installed at Cambridge's Cavendish Laboratory (Ray Dolby Centre). UK's most powerful quantum computer at a university. Research focus includes quantum chemistry, materials, optimization, and quantum communications.
relevance_reason: 256q trapped-ion with all-to-all connectivity (IonQ architecture). 6th-gen chip-based system has improved gate fidelity. Cambridge academic access path. Holographic simulation is in the stated research scope.
access_path: IonQ Quantum Innovation Centre at Cambridge — contact through Cambridge academic channels. IonQ cloud access also available.
